verdict.rationale: Agent payments run on the merchant's existing rails, so they inherit existing settlement. ACP delegated tokens are processed "using your existing Braintree integration," and UCP tokens are "a tokenized credential that Braintree can process." Store Sync orders reach the merchant's order management system "just as it would from any other channel" at standard published fees, and webhooks plus transaction-detail tools support downstream tracking. However, no documentation covers payout, settlement or reporting specifically for agent-originated transactions, nor how to tag or reconcile them as a distinct channel. Missing for 10: documented payout/settlement timing for agentic orders, agent-channel attribution in settlement or reporting exports, an explicit reconciliation guide, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
